name: Phantom Steed
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax. Mapping requirements do not assert the whole referenced engine slice is absent.

rules.text: A Large, quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range.
You decide the creature’s appearance, and it is equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle.
Any of the equipment created by the spell vanishes in a puff of smoke if it is carried more than 10 feet away from the steed.
For the duration, you or a creature you choose can ride the steed.
The steed uses the Riding Horse stat block (see “Monsters”), except it has a Speed of 100 feet and can travel 13 miles in an hour.
When the spell ends, the steed gradually fades, giving the rider 1 minute to dismount.
The spell ends early if the steed takes any damage.
